subject: Urgent: Candidate heat exhaustion at onsite — reschedule and coverage
messages:
From: Sarah Mills <sarah@bluebridgetalent.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: recruiting@bluebridgetalent.com
Date: 2027-04-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate Elliot Barnes — left onsite due to heat exhaustion

Hi Grace / Marissa,

Wanted to flag a situation from this morning. Elliot Barnes (onsite for a full-day loop) started feeling faint after the coding exercise and was taken to urgent care by the event medic. At the time they thought it was dehydration/heat exhaustion; Elliot was treated, observed for a couple of hours and discharged with instructions to rest.

Elliot is very apologetic and obviously upset about missing the remainder of the loop. He asked that I reach out to see if we can:
- reschedule the remainder of the interviews as remote or compressed sessions next week, or
- allow a recorded coding exercise + two 30-min remote follow-ups (panel is fine with that)

He attached a short medical note from urgent care and a travel receipt for reimbursement. He would prefer afternoons next week (Tue–Fri) but is flexible.

I know this is short notice — please let me know what you want me to tell Elliot. He'd also like to confirm any reimbursement/expense process.

Thanks,
Sarah Mills
Senior Recruiter | BlueBridge Talent
(sarah@bluebridgetalent.com)

[attachment: elliot_med_note.pdf (application/pdf)] [attachment: travel_receipt.jpg (image/jpeg)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah@bluebridgetalent.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate Elliot Barnes — left onsite due to heat exhaustion

Thanks for the heads up, Sarah — sorry to hear that happened to Elliot. Please pass along that our first priority is his health; glad he's out of urgent care.

Operationally, let's proceed as follows:
1) Offer Elliot the recorded coding exercise + two 30-minute remote interviews with the hiring panel. That keeps the evaluation parity while avoiding another travel day.
2) Ask Elliot to pick two afternoon slots next week (we'll target 1:00–4:00pm PT).
3) Marissa, can you take point on switching the Greenhouse stage to "Interview deferred" and set up the remote slots? Also please start the expense reimbursement flow — we typically offer a travel credit for day-of disruptions.
4) Jonas, can you weigh in on the reimbursement amount (I'm fine with a reasonable credit).

Sarah — happy for you to share the scheduling options below with Elliot. We'll try to keep the same panel where possible; if anyone can't make it, we'll swap in an equivalent interviewer.

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Hiring Manager, Platform Services
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Hi Grace — thanks for checking in and for the team's flexibility. I'm really sorry for the disruption this morning. I appreciate everyone's concern.

I can do the recorded coding exercise (if you can send the prompt) plus two 30-minute remote interviews. My preference is:
• Thursday, May 6 — 1:00pm PT
• Friday, May 7 — 3:00pm PT

If those don't work, I can also do Wednesday afternoon (May 5) after 2:00pm PT.

I've attached the urgent care note and the travel receipt. Let me know what else you need from me.

— Elliot

Date: 2027-04-29T17:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate Elliot Barnes — left onsite due to heat exhaustion

Thanks Grace / Sarah / Elliot (cc'ing Jonas for approval on reimbursement).

I can convert the remaining onsite loop to:
- recorded coding assignment (same rubric; I'll send instructions and a private link to submit)
- two 30-minute remote interviews (we'll keep the original interviewer pair where possible; if someone is unavailable we will swap with an equivalent senior engineer)

Tentative schedule I'm going to propose in Greenhouse (I'll only finalize after approval):
• Thu May 6 — Coding prompt available at 9:00am PT, submission due by 3:00pm PT
• Thu May 6 — Interview 1 @ 1:00pm PT (30m)
• Fri May 7 — Interview 2 @ 3:00pm PT (30m)

I'll create provisional calendar invites and mark the candidate's profile as "Interview deferred — medical". Elliot, if you prefer a different pairing or need any accommodations for the coding prompt window, say the word.

On travel reimbursement: we typically issue a day-of disruption credit. Elliot submitted a receipt for ground transit; please confirm the mode (Uber/Lyft/Taxi) and I'll process a $150 credit pending Jon's sign-off. If there's a larger expense (medical taxi or ambulance) we'll treat that separately — please share any additional receipts.

Grace — I'll handle the Greenhouse updates and schedule. Sarah — can you forward any other vendor notes to me?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Recruiting Operations | Redwood Inference
